problem:
$\,$ $∀\,ϵ\in {R}^{+},\,∃\,x\in Q,\,-ϵ<x<ϵ.$

Which of the following expresses the statement given above?
worked_solution:
Our quantified statement reads as follows:

$\,$ **For all** $ϵ\in {R}^{+},$ **there exists** $x\in Q$ **such that** $-ϵ<x<ϵ.$ 

This can be re-phrased as follows:

$\,$ Given any real number $ϵ>0$ there exists a rational number $x$ such that $-ϵ<x<ϵ.$

There exists a number $x$ such that for all $ϵ,$ $-ϵ<x<ϵ.$
